fee_notes: Standard IFF is $50,000. Actual range paid in FY2025: $0-$50,000 due to alternative venues, legacy agreements, promotions, and development incentive programs. Veterans Development Incentive Program: $27,500. College Incentive Program and Airport Incentive Program: $12,500. MTRA deposit of $25,000 per committed restaurant credited toward IFF at opening.
raw_excerpt: Under the Franchise Agreement you must pay us a $50,000 franchise fee for a Popeyes Restaurant ("Initial Franchise Fee") before opening the Franchised Restaurant. The Initial Franchise Fees actually paid for new franchises during our fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 ranged from $0 to $50,000 per Popeyes Restaurant.
